description: Get raw historical FX spot-rate rows for a currency pair (e.g. EUR/USD) as a plain-text table, raw rows, exact values, or JSON-like data, without chart metadata. Daily official central-bank reference rates with multi-year history. Optional technical-indicator series (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, etc.) are selected by comma-separated slugs in indicators; interval selects daily or intraday. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

end_date.description: Inclusive upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

end_time.description: intraday only: inclusive RFC 3339 upper bound.

indicators.description: Comma-separated technical-indicator slugs to attach to each row. Supported: adx_14, atr_14, bollinger_bands, cci_20, donchian_20, ema_12, ema_20, ema_200, ema_26, ema_50, macd, macd_histogram, macd_signal, rsi_14, sma_20, sma_200, sma_50, stochastic_14_3, williams_r_14, all.

interval.description: daily (default): spot history. intraday: timestamped official intraday reference-rate fixings for the pair, bounded by start_time and end_time.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

start_date.description: Inclusive lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to ~5 years ago.

start_time.description: intraday only: inclusive RFC 3339 lower bound.

name: forex
title: FX Spot Rates
